_notes: 40 items total, 10 per intended category. This is a fixed candidate set, not evidence that any model has been run.
Score source_qa references against the exact checked-out local Quran translation before reporting model scores; translations may vary. Do not edit items after inspecting model responses.
Poetry attribution examples use well-known attributions but must still be audited against the exact corpus where corpus-relative accuracy is claimed.
Scoring uses literal expected_any matching except classify, which should be exact-label match after the evaluation-harness patch.
For model comparison, run each endpoint both with and without SIMORGH-style local retrieval context. Save separate timestamped JSON outputs.

Version v2 corrects poetry-01 wording from the commonly repeated 'یک پیکرند' to the common Golestan text 'اعضای یکدیگرند' before any model run. See source note in docs/paper/REFERENCE_AUDIT_2026-10-12.md; still audit the exact local corpus before making corpus-relative claims.

items.prompt: در پایگاه نصب‌شدهٔ سیمرغ، شخص ثبت‌شده با شناسهٔ فرضی SIM-FA-99173 چه نامی دارد؟ اگر رکوردی در دسترس نیست، بگو نمی‌دانم.
